stem.text: A ball is released from rest and falls vertically to the ground.
The kinetic energy $E_\text{K}$ of the ball varies as the height $h$ of the ball above the ground changes.
Which graph shows the variation of $E_\text{K}$ with $h$?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis E_K and horizontal axis h, both starting at 0. A curve rises from the origin, becoming steeper as h increases.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis E_K and horizontal axis h, both starting at 0. A straight line rises from the origin.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis E_K and horizontal axis h, with h labelled and 0 marked on both axes. A curve starts above the origin on the vertical axis and falls to meet the horizontal axis.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis E_K and horizontal axis h, with h labelled and 0 marked on both axes. A straight line starts above the origin on the vertical axis and falls to meet the horizontal axis.
